issue_request: FHIR-33432 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking that ElementDefinition.path clarify that polymorphic choice paths may end in [x] even though bracket characters are not part of ordinary element names.
initial_application: Commit b1329db957738e422efb1a88e83984e1f00528d7 added the requested paragraph to source/elementdefinition.html; commit 8592e1207273b786db340efb927bb6d1dc9756c9 later changed only the spelling from data type to datatype.
additional_context: The origin Zulip thread and FHIR-I WGM minutes support the same distinction between element names and [x] path notation. ElementDefinition is active/normative in source/fhir.ini. Later same-page issues FHIR-39180 and FHIR-39182 corrected choice-element examples but did not alter this rule.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because source/elementdefinition.html already states that polymorphic element paths SHALL end in [x] and that [x] is not part of the official element name.
